BiblicalUsage: Shuppim was an Israelite of Benjamin's line, named with Huppim among the children of Ir, and his sister Maachah married Machir. The gate lot westward fell to Shuppim and Hosah by the gate Shallecheth, ward against ward, in the temple service.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the gate lots were drawn by the Lord, not by luck. Shuppim stood his ward at the western gate, and I hold that God assigns every porter his place.
